package domain

import (
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"testing"
)

func TestNormalizeTeacherNextActionRejectsInventedOrExecutableWait(t *testing.T) {
	a := TeacherNextAction{Schema: TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion, PolicyVersion: TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion, Status: "WAITING", SecondaryActions: []NextActionChoice{}, ReasonCode: "validation_running", SourceVersions: TeacherNextActionSourceVersions{StateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}
	_, err := NormalizeTeacherNextAction(a)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	a.Primary = &NextActionChoice{Kind: "WAIT_FOR_VALIDATION"}
	_, err = NormalizeTeacherNextAction(a)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	a.Status = "READY"
	a.Primary.Kind = "complete_onboarding"
	_, err = NormalizeTeacherNextAction(a)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
}
